fact: The SATREPS project (adopted FY2018, five years) with the University of Djibouti, the Centre for Studies and Research of Djibouti and the Ministry of Agriculture uses satellite and UAV images taken throughout Djibouti to assess greening and sheep-farming potential for agropastoral practices.
title: Advanced and Sustainable Methods on Water Utilization Associated with Greening Potential Evaluation
